title: Item:Draconic Raider's Reward Box
wikitext: [[File:Draconic Raider's Reward Box.png|thumb|right]] '''Draconic Raiders Reward Box''' is a freebie available from August 28th through September 24th, 2024, as part of the [[Year of the Dragon]] event. The box allows you to select one of a number of historic raid items from the game in addition to a cosmetic or Isle of Dread [[Dinosaur Bone crafting]] Black Pearls. {| class="wikitable sortable" |- ! Pet || a very rare chest drop from [[Caught in the Web]] and [[The Fall of Truth]] || [[Menace of the Underdark]], [[Ruins of Gianthold]] |- |} == Notes == * The Draconic Raider’s Reward Box is Bound to Account. All of its contents except [[Item:Dreamspitter|Dreamspitter]], [[Item:Legendary Sword of Shadow|Legendary Sword of Shadow]] and the [[Item:Black Pearl|Black Pearls]] are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}, so make sure to pass the box to the character that needs any other item ''before'' opening it. * The list contains historic raid items except for Eon, the Poisoned Reign, a new Long Bow that was released in the box and has yet to be released in any other fashion. Its minimum level is 31, it accepts Sentience, and has an empty Orange and Purple Augment Slot. * Only one box is delivered to a single character on each game world - once you've claimed the box, it will be sent to the first character to log in on each server you play on. Make sure to select the item on the game world and character you wish to associate the item to. * The Violet Gelatinous Cube-let is a Bound to Character Creature Companion Certificate that, once consumed, will add the creature companion to your account’s stable for that particular game world. The Cube-let is much rarer than is standard for a raid item (it cannot be obtained except via random chance and has a very low drop rate.) * A number of items in this list may also be crafted into [[Set Augment]]s ({{Item|Cloak of the Mountain}}, {{Item|Guided Sight}}, {{Item|Mail of the Mroranon}}, and {{Item|Page Regalia: Exiled Tactica}}) or [[Essence Augment]]s ({{Item|Cobalt Guard}}, {{Item|Dethek Runestone}}, and {{Item|Nullscale Armor}}). * If you cannot redeem anything from the box, make sure the box is not locked in your inventory.
